lines: Rahul Bahri, Investor Selling Shareholder, is receiving money by selling up to 1,800 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹0.24 crore, if all offered shares are sold; the money arrived 8 months ago.
Their unlocked retained shares, valued at ₹0.57 crore (estimate), mean more value remains for a later conversation.
